description.content: Adds a Git panel to the right Sidebar that manages the session worktree's repository: branch and upstream state, staging per file or per group, committing with a diff view, commit history lanes, branch switching, stash, fetch/pull/push, and per-hunk conflict resolution.
在右侧栏新增 Git 面板，直接管理会话工作目录所在的仓库：分支与上游状态、按文件或分组暂存、带差异视图的提交、提交历史泳道图、分支切换、储藏、fetch/pull/push，以及逐区冲突解决。
